rootCauseOneLine: #1708 added `fileOpenerOwner` to plugin file-opener tabs and to the app-local schema but not to the strict `plugin-panel` branch of `threadTabSchema` in packages/server-contract/src/api/thread-tabs.ts; thread-tabs-sync.ts runs `threadTabsSchema.parse(tabs)` before every PUT, so zod throws unrecognized_keys, no PUT is sent, the "Couldn't sync tabs" toast shows the ZodError JSON, and the whole tab list (Docs tab included) is never persisted (lost on reload, or reconciled away immediately for non-click opens).
proposedFix: Add an optional `fileOpenerOwner` (discriminated union of workspace-file-preview / host-file-preview / thread-storage-file-preview owner shapes, mirroring apps/app/src/lib/fixed-panel-tabs-state.ts) to the strict `plugin-panel` branch of `threadTabSchema` in packages/server-contract/src/api/thread-tabs.ts (diff in 1773/repro/proposed-fix.diff). Verified: repro tests pass, existing tab/sync/server suites pass, turbo typecheck for server-contract/app/server passes, and live Diff-panel open now PUTs 200 with no toast and survives reload. Regenerate the committed plugin-sdk bundled types (packages/plugin-sdk/bundled-types, packages/templates generated dts) in the same PR; ideally drop the duplicate app-side owner schema or add a test that parses buildFileOpenerPanelTab() output with threadTabsSchema so the two schemas cannot drift again. No HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump needed (app<->server only).
caveats: Repro was done in the web app on Linux (reporter: desktop 0.38.0 on macOS); the code path is platform-independent. Docs edit-saving was not exercised (unrelated to tab sync). Two behaviours were observed depending on how the open is triggered: via a Diff-panel click the Docs tab renders and is lost on reload; via `bb thread open` the tab is reconciled away in the same render pass and never appears — the issue only describes the first. The worktree was initially created at a108fa7ef (origin/main tip) rather than 16ceb3a54; I checked out 16ceb3a54 before the live repro (no relevant files differ). New-tab "Search files"/Recent items do not route through the file-opener diversion (separate observation, not the bug). I ran `dev-browser --browser bb1773 stop`, which stopped the shared dev-browser daemon (other agents' browsers relaunch automatically on next use). Two untracked repro test files remain in the worktree; the contract fix was reverted.
